chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
O son of Adam, when you see your Lord, the Glorified, continuing to bestow His favours upon you while you are disobeying Him, then fear Him.
ai.seo_question: What should one feel when God continues to bless them while they are disobeying Him?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) exhorts humanity to fear God's majesty when He continues to shower His blessings and favours upon them despite their disobedience, a concept known in Shia tafsir as 'istidraj' (gradual ensnarement). This paradox of divine grace amidst human sinfulness serves as a subtle warning that continued favor may precede a sudden, decisive punishment, urging believers to maintain vigilance rather than complacency.
